To Whom It May Concern,  

Gaurav Saxena has spent the past three years as a QA Engineer at NexaCorp, where he has consistently delivered high-impact results across complex enterprise projects. As his direct manager, I’ve observed his ability to bridge technical rigor with strategic thinking, ensuring quality without compromising delivery timelines.  

Gaurav’s strength lies in his systematic approach to test strategy design. He once spearheaded a framework that streamlined API testing for a critical financial integration platform, reducing bug escapes by 40% during the go-live phase. His ownership of Selenium and Playwright automation suites has also been pivotal—particularly in a recent project where he refactored 200+ test scripts, cutting regression cycles by 30% and enabling the team to prioritize high-risk areas.  

What sets him apart is his proactive mindset. When a legacy system’s REST API underwent a major overhaul, Gaurav led the design of a hybrid testing approach that balanced manual exploration with automated validation, ensuring seamless transitions without service interruptions. He also developed Python-based tools to automate data pipeline checks, which saved the team over 50 hours monthly.  

Beyond technical skill, Gaurav’s reliability and collaborative spirit are standout traits. He consistently volunteers to mentor junior engineers and has a knack for simplifying complex systems, making him an invaluable asset to any team.  

I am confident he will bring the same level of dedication and precision to his next role.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
NexaCorp
